answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 6411 Country: SG Title: I am a 23 year old girl, diagnosed with PCOS a few months ago.Ive excessive hair growth on my body & have gained more than 20kg in 1 year. I have also been losing a lot of hair for the past 9 years.In this past 2 years im also suddenly experiencing many health complications and doctors are unable to determine why.I recently went to an Muslim healing man who practices Ayurvedic Medicine.He told me that someone in my past has practised black magic on me & I thus have such complications.Are there any prayers or recitations I can do to get rid of this curse and regain my health back? Also, I hear strange noises around me at night when I sleep and often find it hard to sleep.There seems to be a lot of jin activities going around in my house? Can i pray or ready anything to get rid of this as well? Please help! Question: Assalamualaikum. I am a 23 year old girl, diagnosed with PCOS a few months ago.Ive excessive hair growth on my body & have gained more than 20kg in 1 year. I have also been losing a lot of hair for the past 9 years.In this past 2 years im also suddenly experiencing many health complications and doctors are unable to determine why.I recently went to an Muslim healing man who practices Ayurvedic Medicine.He told me that someone in my past has practised black magic on me & I thus have such complications.Are there any prayers or recitations I can do to get rid of this curse and regain my health back? Also, I hear strange noises around me at night when I sleep and often find it hard to sleep.There seems to be a lot of jin activities going around in my house? Can i pray or ready anything to get rid of this as well? Please help!! Wassalam Answer ID: 6411 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1305/1115=B/1429) Recite آیۃ الکرسی after every obligatory salah and blow on the body. Reciting سورۃ الفلق and سورۃ الناس is also very useful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
